description: This file contains a Python module for analyzing gaps between user competencies and target role requirements in a career platform. It includes functions for scoring levels, fetching competency data asynchronously from a database, and performing the gap analysis based on provided data.

classes.name: GapItem
classes.description: A data structure representing a competency gap, including id, name, current, and required levels.

classes.name: GapAnalysisResult
classes.description: A data structure representing the result of a gap analysis, including target role, current competencies, and identified gaps.

methods.name: int _score(level: str | int | None)
methods.description: Converts a competency level (string or int) to an integer score for comparison.

methods.name: Dict[str,Competency] _get_competency_lookup(session: AsyncSession, ids: List[str])
methods.description: Fetches Competency objects from the database given a list of competency IDs.

methods.name: GapAnalysisResult analyze_gaps(session: AsyncSession, payload: GapAnalysisRequest)
methods.description: Main function that performs gap analysis between current competencies and role requirements.

ctags.name: _get_competency_lookup
ctags.pattern: /^async def _get_competency_lookup(session: AsyncSession, ids: List[str]) -> Dict[str, Competency]/

ctags.name: analyze_gaps
ctags.pattern: /^async def analyze_gaps(session: AsyncSession, payload: GapAnalysisRequest) -> GapAnalysisResult:$/
